Text: 🚨 @FIRECRAWL JUST OPEN-SOURCED A MASSIVE UTILITY FOR AI DEVS

It is called anydoc.

It is a Rust library that converts almost any office document into clean Markdown in milliseconds.

No models involved.

Just pure speed.

What makes it interesting:
→ Supports Word, PPT, Excel, PDF, EPUB, CSV
→ Uses one shared document model for consistent output
→ Runs locally via WebAssembly or CLI
→ MIT licensed with 10.8k stars

You can also drop it straight into Claude Code or Cursor as an agent skill with a single command.

100% free and open-source.
